description: Tasman Council Maintained Roads is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Tasmania Government's The List Data. Tasman Council Maintained Roads is a spatial index of the Tasman Council Road Network. Tasman Council Maintained Roads contains geometry and attribute data for all roads within the Tasman Municipality including roads that are not maintained by Council. Attributes of Tasman Council Maintained Roads include Asset ID, Name, Maintained, Surface, Segment and Length. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Tasmania Government's The List Data. Its tags are UTILITIES-Any. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
